title: Simplify-UI is not working on Galaxy Watch 6 Classic.
body:
Simplify-UI is not working on Galaxy Watch 6 Classic. 

Tested with all AAPS watch faces. 

When i go sleeping, i switch my watch into sleeping mode, the display entering in "grey-mode" but it doesn't show me the simplify-ui (only time, BG and direction). 

When i load the watch, the simplify-ui works (but only some seconds, then the watch switch to "charging indicator") but by tipping on the screen, the simplify-ui comes back.

I tested all settings in the watch face configuration (Simplify UI: off, while charging, always on mode, always on and charging) when i use "while charging" or "always on and charging" the watch shows me the simplify-ui but only i loading the watch. I don't have the setting "always on" (i find it in the AAPS-Docs) in the watch face configuration.

It doesn't matter if i have the AOD on or off, it still doesn't work.

AAPS 3-2-0-4
AAPS Wear build at the same time as AAPS
Handy: Samsung Galaxy S23 ultra (Android 14 - OneUI 6.1)
Watch: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Classic (WearOS 4.0 - OneUI 5.0 Watch)

comments.body:
"Allways On" is not an AAPS or a Watchface parameter, but a watch parameter.

To find it slide down on watch to access to watch parameter, then click on icon below:
![Screenshot_20241113_130729_sysui.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9755623f-9c2a-49fd-b7a0-e3db75753e45)

You can also access within Watch parameter > Screen > Always On Display
![Screenshot_20241113_131949_settings.png](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c483a55c-4143-40d5-a556-69e9d584fcd5)

Tell me if it works with Always On Display enabled (be carefull, without charging, always on will reduce watch autonomy, so it's better to disable it during the day 😉)
